items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was another thing with Lubinsky and all of them that I had made records for before.

ctx.x: It wasn’t promoted properly. That was another thing with Lubinsky and all of them that I had made records for before. They didn’t promote anything. The records are out there, even now.
When The Source came out, and there was a picture of a woman on the cover, did that anger you?
